description: substack: Publication posts. GET /v1/substack/posts. Latest public posts on a publication. Pass a hostname, or a name that lives at name.substack.com. An empty page costs 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when posts is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Serve a cached response when it is newer than this. A cache hit costs 0 credits.
